## Choose an R function

```{r example-choice-options, echo=FALSE}
q_example_choice_options <- c("mean()", "plot()", "read.csv()")
q_example_choice_answer <- "mean()"
```

Which function calculates an arithmetic mean?

**Answer:** `r quiz_singlechoice(q_example_choice_answer, q_example_choice_options)`

::: unilur-solution
`mean()` calculates an arithmetic mean.
:::
